Co-Located Special Track on

Disease Modeling

Following its successful launch in 2026, Disease Modeling will continue as a dedicated special track at BioCHIP Berlin in 2027. This track provides a platform for researchers, technologists, and industry experts to connect disease modeling research, technologies, and products with industry users and potential partners, fostering collaboration, model development, technology transfer, and commercialization.

Interdisciplinary meetup: who should attend

  • Researchers and developers of in vitro disease models and technologies.
  • End-users of disease models in research and drug development.
  • Providers of disease models, platforms, enabling technologies, and assay development and screening services.
  • Organizations seeking custom model development or co-development.
  • Partners interested in technology transfer and commercialization.

Focal Topics

  • Disease Model Technologies & Engineering: Technologies and engineering approaches for the design and development of in vitro disease models.
  • Disease Modeling Products & Platforms: Ready-to-use human disease models and disease-relevant cell products for major disease areas, such as oncology, neurological and cardiovascular diseases, as well as organoids and other model platforms.
  • Assay Development & Screening: Disease model characterization, disease-relevant assay development, functional and phenotypic screening, drug response and efficacy assessment.
  • Custom Disease Model Development & Services: Custom disease model development, contract research, and collaborative development services.

Ready to submit a proposal?

Special topic track is part of the Forum and included within the main conference program. Thus, the same rules for submissions apply as for the main conference.
